title: Rugby
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Modified, non-contact rugby with a coach; questions ask for names and rules only.

skills.key_step: The child tells the basic, spin and pop passes, says passes go sideways or backwards only, and tells the place kick from the drop kick.

floor.question: Name one netball pass.
floor.answer: any of: chest, bounce, shoulder, overhead

steps: Basic pass for short distance; spin for long; pop for close.
Place kick off a tee; drop kick off the bounce.

board.do: May the ball be passed forward?

misconceptions.ask: In which direction may a rugby ball be passed?
misconceptions.repair: Walk through a line passing backwards as it moves forward.

misconceptions.ask: Which pass suits a team mate running very close: spin or pop?
misconceptions.repair: Try both to a close runner.

misconceptions.ask: A ball is kicked from a kicking tee. Which kick is it?
misconceptions.repair: Show the tee for a place kick and the bounce for a drop kick.

listen_for: at the ball in your hands
misconceptions.ask: Where should you look when passing in rugby?
misconceptions.repair: Pass while calling out the catcher's name.

checks.question: Which way may a rugby ball be passed?
Which pass is for a long, fast pass?
